text: School Line Pro. Here's what's new in the school app built for Ghanaian schools.
Parents can now watch the school bus live on the map, on its way to their child's stop.
They get a notification when the bus is five minutes away, when their child gets on, and when they're dropped off. And one tap calls the driver.
The driver and bus attendant run each trip from their phones. Both share the bus location, and the attendant ticks children on and off.
Create the whole timetable in one tap. Every subject gets a fair share, with no teacher clashes. Not happy? Press undo.
Build exam timetables with rooms and invigilators. Clashes are caught before you publish.
Teachers enter marks only for the subjects they teach, and find any student by name or admission number.
Billing fits your school. Admission fees for new students, transport only for bus users, plus extra charges and discounts.
Set your terms, and the weeks are worked out for you. New schools get every class and subject set up automatically.
Parents link their own children, the gate kiosk ticks class registers, and only the class teacher can start a live class.
School Line Pro. Run your whole school from one app. Try the free demo today.
